_comment: Properties the API returns that the official spec omits, found with audit-live. Keyed by operationId, then by the path of the object to add them to: '' is the response (each item, for an array response), 'a.b' descends through properties, 'a[]' into array items. Existing properties are never replaced. Report 'properties' is left a free-form map: its keys depend on the report type, and typing it would change the SDKs' map to a struct.

primaryKey.description: Whether the field is the table's key field.

summaryQuery.description: The summary field's filter (matching criteria) in Quickbase query language, when it has one.

masterTableId.description: For a reference field: the id of the parent table in its relationship.

masterTableKeyFid.description: For a reference field: the parent table's key field id.

fieldCaching.description: For a reference field: whether lookup values through it are cached.

openTargetIn.description: For a reference field: where the parent record opens when the link is followed.
